responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exposes the builtin-function and builtin-constant services provided by m2builtins.cc. It declares queries for builtin constants and type-information pseudo-constants, existence checks, tree builders for named builtins, and specific helpers used by code generation for stack allocation, memcpy, and finite-value tests, making GCC builtin facilities callable from the Modula-2 half of the frontend.
same_name_distinction: This is the Modula-2-facing declaration module for builtin services, exposing lookup and builder procedures such as BuiltInMemCopy, BuiltInAlloca, and BuiltInIsfinite to Modula-2 code. Unlike m2builtins.h it is not the C header, and unlike m2builtins.cc it does not create or register any builtin decls.
